title: Present Perfect with for and since
grammarNote:
"For" и "since" с Present Perfect — действия начались в прошлом и ПРОДОЛЖАЮТСЯ сейчас.

📌 FOR — период времени (КАК ДОЛГО? = how long?)
"I have lived in Uralsk for five years." (пять лет)
"She has studied English for three months."

С "for": minutes · hours · days · weeks · months · years · ages · a long time

📌 SINCE — точка отсчёта (С КАКОГО МОМЕНТА? = since when?)
"I have lived here since 2019." (с 2019 года)
"She has studied since January."

С "since": конкретный год, месяц, день, или событие

💡 Простое правило:
FOR + период → for five years / for a week / for ages
SINCE + момент → since 2020 / since Monday / since I was a child

⚠️ Типичные ошибки:
❌ "I live here for 5 years." → ✅ "I HAVE LIVED here for 5 years."
❌ "She is here since Monday." → ✅ "She HAS BEEN here since Monday."

grammarTip:
Запомни через вопросы:

FOR → "КАК ДОЛГО?" (период)
for 3 years · for a week · for two months · for ages

SINCE → "С КАКОГО МОМЕНТА?" (точка)
since 2020 · since Monday · since morning · since I was born

🎯 Практика — выбери for или since:
"I have known her ___ 10 years." → for
"She has worked here ___ January." → since
"He has studied ___ he was 7." → since
"We haven't met ___ a long time." → for
